name: Cage
concept: The artist starts locked in a cage of light in the middle of the crowd and breaks it open.
object: A 4 x 4 m riser in the centre of the floor wrapped by 64 vertical light tubes that rise from the floor
photoMoment: The tubes dropping into the floor in one sweep while the crowd closes in around the riser.

elements.note: 64 pixel tubes on a 6 x 6 m square footprint (16 per side), rising out of floor pods.
Main deck becomes the DJ / band booth.
Square truss over the riser: key lights and 4 beams.

acts.name: Locked
acts.state: Tubes fully up at 4 m, artist inside.
acts.light: Red tubes, cold ice key from above.

acts.name: Bars
acts.state: Tubes chase around the square; single tubes drop and return on hits.
acts.light: Red and ice alternating per bar.

acts.name: Break-out
acts.state: All 64 tubes drop into the floor in one sweep; crowd closes in.
acts.light: Blackout for one beat, then white beams from the truss.

acts.name: Rave
acts.state: Tubes pulse at floor height like a lit floor edge; CO2 from the four corners.
acts.light: Strobes and ice, end on a red flash.

buildNotes: Needs a central security ring of 1 m. In-game: tubes are instanced; the riser blocks crowd spawn in a 7 x 7 m square at the floor centre.
